name: snomed-ct
label: SNOMED CT (Schema)
description: SNOMED Clinical Terms — 350,000+ clinical concepts. Schema only; load data via: flask forge templates install-data snomed-ct (requires NLM UMLS license)

snomed_concept.name: id
snomed_concept.description: SNOMED CT concept identifier (SCTID) — 18-digit integer, globally unique

snomed_concept.name: effective_time
snomed_concept.description: Release date when this concept version became effective (YYYYMMDD format in source)

snomed_concept.name: active
snomed_concept.description: True if this concept is currently active; False if retired/deprecated

snomed_concept.name: module_id
snomed_concept.description: SCTID of the module this concept belongs to (e.g. 900000000000207008 = SNOMED CT core)

snomed_description.name: id
snomed_description.description: Description SCTID — unique identifier for this term/synonym

snomed_description.name: effective_time
snomed_description.description: Release date when this description version became effective

snomed_description.name: active
snomed_description.description: True if this description is currently active

snomed_description.name: module_id
snomed_description.description: SCTID of the module containing this description

snomed_description.name: concept_id
snomed_description.description: SCTID of the concept this description belongs to

snomed_description.name: language_code
snomed_description.description: ISO 639-1 language code (e.g. en, fr, de)

snomed_description.name: term
snomed_description.description: The actual text of the description/synonym (clinically precise name)

snomed_description.name: case_significance_id
snomed_description.description: Case sensitivity: CS=case sensitive, CI=case insensitive, cI=initial char

snomed_description.name: search_vector
snomed_description.description: PostgreSQL FTS vector over term for fast full-text search across all descriptions

snomed_relationship.name: id
snomed_relationship.description: Relationship SCTID — unique identifier for this relationship instance

snomed_relationship.name: effective_time
snomed_relationship.description: Release date when this relationship version became effective

snomed_relationship.name: active
snomed_relationship.description: True if relationship is currently active in the hierarchy

snomed_relationship.name: source_id
snomed_relationship.description: SCTID of the concept on the source (child) side of the relationship

snomed_relationship.name: destination_id
snomed_relationship.description: SCTID of the concept on the destination (parent/target) side

snomed_transitive_closure.name: id
snomed_transitive_closure.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for fast lookups

snomed_transitive_closure.name: super_type_id
snomed_transitive_closure.description: Ancestor concept SCTID (any level up the Is-a hierarchy)

snomed_transitive_closure.name: sub_type_id
snomed_transitive_closure.description: Descendant concept SCTID — allows "find all X and its subtypes" in O(1)

short_description: SNOMED Clinical Terms — 350,000+ clinical concepts. Schema only; load data via: flask forge templates install-data snomed-ct (requires NLM UMLS license)
long_description: SNOMED CT is the world's most comprehensive clinical health terminology with 350,000+ clinical concepts organized in a poly-hierarchy. The schema includes the RF2 release format tables: concepts, descriptions (preferred terms, synonyms), relationships (is-a, finding site, etc.), and transitive closure for subsumption queries. Requires UMLS license for US use; other countries may have free access via SNOMED International.
when_to_use: Use for clinical decision support, problem list encoding, allergy recording, and clinical documentation requiring standard clinical terms. Required by UK NHS, mandated in many EU countries, and recommended by US ONC. Pair with FHIR R4 for complete clinical interoperability. Load data via: flask forge templates install-data snomed-ct

table_notes.snomed_concept: All 350,000+ SNOMED CT concepts. Each concept is a clinical entity (disease, finding, procedure, substance). Query with transitive_closure for subsumption (find all subtypes).
table_notes.snomed_description: All terms/synonyms for each concept — Fully Specified Names plus synonyms in multiple languages. Build GIN index on search_vector for fast clinical term search.
table_notes.snomed_relationship: Relationships between concepts (Is-a hierarchy + clinical attributes like Finding site, Causative agent). The Is-a (116680003) relationships form the concept hierarchy.
table_notes.snomed_transitive_closure: Pre-computed transitive closure of the Is-a hierarchy. Enables O(1) subsumption queries: SELECT * FROM conditions WHERE concept_id IN (SELECT sub_type_id FROM snomed_transitive_closure WHERE super_type_id = 73211009) finds all diabetes subtypes.
